# LetterGradeField

## Summary

LetterGradeField is the letter-grade enum the grading skill is allowed to award — a `StringField` enum over A, B, C, D, E, and F. It backs `GradeField.overallGrade`, so the edit UI renders a picker rather than free text and the grading skill can only patch in a value from the scale it was given.

## Import

```js
import { LetterGradeField } from '../homework-grader';
```

## Usage as a Field

```ts
@field overallGrade = contains(LetterGradeField);
```

## Template Usage

```handlebars
{{@model.overallGrade}}
```
